@pattern(diamond:2) Light blocks Eclipse darkness on these tiles. The marked ground and other attacks can still hit.

copy.Watch Brazier · Light radius 2: @pattern(diamond:2) Watch Brazier · Light on these tiles

copy.A trap triggers when a unit enters its t: @pattern(cross) @pattern(neighbors:origin) A trap triggers when a unit enters its tile or an attack hits that tile. The trap damages the unit on its tile, then leaves its element on that tile and each tile next to it. An Air trap leaves no ground: it pushes each unit next to it 1 tile away.
copy.Trigger when entered or attacked. Damage: @pattern(cross) Trigger when entered or attacked. Damage the unit on them, then leave their element on their tile and each tile next to it.
copy.Powder kegs and Worldspines are raised t: @pattern(cross) @pattern(neighbors:origin) Powder kegs and Worldspines are raised the same way. A keg blocks movement but not sight; when anything destroys it, it deals its damage to its tile and each tile next to it, setting off other kegs. Your Worldspines pulse at the start of each of your turns, hitting each enemy next to one of them once.
copy.Some illusions carry an effect while the: @pattern(neighbors:origin) Some illusions carry an effect while they live: enemies that damage a charged illusion take damage back (once per enemy attack), and a Doppelganger lets your ranged attacks fire from its tile. Mirror Feint places its illusion beside an enemy; Hall of Mirrors fills every empty tile next to you.
copy.Melee means a melee attack or any attack: @pattern(neighbors:origin) Melee means a melee attack or any attack made from a tile next to you. Retaliate triggers once per enemy attack. Several Retaliates add their damage and Bleed; Shock and Push use the largest.
copy.Meteorfall strikes marked tiles and leav: @pattern(neighbors:origin) Meteorfall strikes marked tiles and leaves Fire. When Vyraketh breathes, every Fire tile spreads 1 tile in all four directions.
copy.The Meteorfall card marks a line of tile: @pattern(line:3) The Meteorfall card marks a line of tiles the same way. The marks stay through enemy turns; at the start of your next turn, before you draw, each marked tile takes the damage (anyone standing there, including you) and becomes Fire.
copy.Hollow Gale strikes everywhere within 2: @pattern(body_area:2) Hollow Gale strikes everywhere within 2 tiles of Vaeloryx and Pushes struck actors away.
copy.Eye of the Storm threatens a wide ring a: @pattern(ring_2:5) Eye of the Storm threatens a wide ring after the dragon retreats. Escape the outer edge, or step into the eye and face a weaker bite.
copy.Squall pushes each enemy in its cross aw: @pattern(cross) Squall pushes each enemy in its cross away from the cross's center; the enemy on the center itself is pushed away from you.
copy.After each Vaeloryx turn, its wind Pushe: @pattern(ring_2:5) After each Vaeloryx turn, its wind Pushes everyone 1 tile, then turns a quarter clockwise. At half Health it Pushes 2 tiles. Its retreating storm combines a wide ring with a weaker close bite.
copy.When it dies, it deals the shown damage: @pattern(surround:origin) When it dies, it deals the shown damage to every unit in the 8 tiles around it, then leaves Fire.
copy.The darkest Umbra stage: you see only 1: @pattern(cross:hero) The darkest Umbra stage: you see only 1 tile around you. Light still reveals; Dispel Umbra lowers it.
copy.Gain 1 more @kw(movement) each turn. Mov: @pattern(cross) Gain 1 more @kw(movement) each turn. Moving leaves @term(illuminate) for 2 turns on these tiles centered on each tile you enter, unless the card attacks. @kw(blink) lights both ends.
copy.When you kill a @term(freeze|Frozen) ene: @pattern(cross) When you kill a @term(freeze|Frozen) enemy with an attack, leave @term(surface_rubble) on these tiles centered on it.
copy.Excess healing becomes @term(stoneskin),: @pattern(cross:hero) Excess healing becomes @term(stoneskin), up to 8 each turn. It also creates @term(illuminate) on these tiles around you for 2 turns, once per turn.
copy.When an enemy dies on @term(surface_fire: @pattern(neighbors:origin) When an enemy dies on @term(surface_fire), @kw(surface_fire) spreads to each of these tiles without @kw(surface_fire), @term(surface_ice) or @term(surface_electrified).
copy.Your single-target @kw(melee) can spend: @pattern(cross) Your single-target @kw(melee) can spend 4 @term(stoneskin) to strike these tiles instead, leaving @term(surface_rubble) on them.
copy.When you place @term(surface_fire), @ter: @pattern(neighbors:origin) When you place @term(surface_fire), @term(surface_ice) or @term(surface_electrified) over a different one, it also spreads to each of these tiles that has none.
copy.Your @kw(detonate) @kw(surface_consume|E: @pattern(cross) Your @kw(detonate) @kw(surface_consume|Expends) all connected @term(surface_fire). A target hit by several blasts takes 25% more damage per extra blast.
copy.Your first @kw(blink) each turn leaves a: @pattern(diamond:2) Your first @kw(blink) each turn leaves a 2-@term(health) @term(illusion) where you started. Your @kw(illusion|Illusions) shed @term(illuminate) on these tiles.
copy.At the start of combat, create radius-2: @pattern(diamond:2:hero) At the start of combat, create @term(illuminate) centered on your tile for 3 turns.
copy.When Vyraketh breathes, every Fire tile: @pattern(neighbors:origin) When Vyraketh breathes, every Fire tile spreads to these tiles.
copy.After every second Vyraketh turn, every: @pattern(neighbors:origin) After every second Vyraketh turn, every Fire tile spreads to these tiles.
copy.Leaves this ground on each empty tile ne: @pattern(neighbors:origin) Leaves this ground on each empty one of these tiles next to the illusion.
copy.A tile is legal only when the raise keep: @pattern(neighbors:origin) A tile is legal only when the raise keeps every floor tile connected, so an outcrop can never seal the hero, an enemy, a pickup or an exit away. A Worldspine cage is the one exception: it may seal the single tile it surrounds.
copy.When Vyraketh breathes, every Fire tile: @pattern(neighbors:origin) When Vyraketh breathes, every Fire tile spreads 1 tile in all four directions. At half Health its Fire spreads after every second Vyraketh turn. Crownfire detonates its own marked Fire, and its bite renews the marks.
copy.Kill the captain and the rest flee. Foll: @pattern(diamond:2) Kill the captain and the rest flee. Followers on these tiles around it deal +1 damage.
copy.Rockburst and Worldbreak destroy terrain: @pattern(neighbors:origin) @pattern(beyond:3:origin) Rockburst and Worldbreak destroy terrain to blast the enemies next to it, or the line beyond an outcrop you raised.
copy.Melee actions target adjacent or pattern: @pattern(neighbors:origin) Melee actions target adjacent or pattern-defined nearby tiles. Ranged actions require a legal range and line-of-sight path.
copy.Lights tiles within its radius through t: Lights tiles within the shown distance through the Umbra.
copy.Creates light that reveals nearby Umbra: Creates light that reveals nearby Umbra out to the displayed distance. Its duration counts down on player turns.
copy.Reveals tiles within its radius through: Reveals tiles within the shown distance through the Umbra for the shown number of your turns.
copy.Widen your sight radius by that much for: See that many tiles farther for the shown turns. It creates no Light.
copy.Tharokh marks a line of tiles between yo: Tharokh marks tiles between you and it. After every second turn of yours, Tharokh's marked tiles rise as Outcrops unless something immovable is on them. At half Health they rise after each of your turns.
copy.An area force pushes or pulls every enem: An area force pushes or pulls every enemy within the shown distance of its center: you, or a tile you choose. Each enemy moves directly away from (Push) or toward (Pull) the center, using the normal Push and Pull rules. An enemy standing on a Pull's center stays put.
copy.Pushes resolve farthest from the center: Pushes resolve farthest from the center first; pulls resolve nearest first. An enemy stopped while moving collides as usual: 2 damage per lost tile to the mover and to what stopped it.
copy.Marked tiles rise as Outcrops when the r: Marked tiles rise as Outcrops when the rule fires. A unit on a rising tile is pushed to a free tile beside it; the tile stays flat if a wall, a trap, a brazier or a unit that can't be pushed off is on it. Outcrops can be broken like any terrain, even from inside when they surround you.
